notes:
Orrery 0.16.0

Dueling
- ATK and DEF changes from card text are worked out for you: Field Spells and other cards that boost an archetype, Type or Attribute; "gains ATK for each" cards in the GY or banishment; Equip Spells; and Traps or Spells that become monsters. A badge shows the change and its tooltip lists where it came from. Pendulum Effects count while the card sits in a Pendulum Zone. Turn it off from the Deck menu or by right-clicking the badge.
- Duel calculator: a sum box beside the field whose answer can be taken from or added to your LP.
- Move Several: send several cards from the GY, banishment or hand to one place at once.
- Check Field hides the duel results so you can look over the final board, with a button to bring them back.
- A chain whose wait runs out now resolves on both players' fields.
- A monster's own voice line and drawn effect play on its summon, not every time its effect is used.
- High Dragon, Omega Psychic, Celestial Warrior and Magical Knight count as their broader Types for Type locks.
- Open lobbies reach friends on Tailscale.

Packs and collecting
- Alt arts can now come out of packs, each at its own rarity.
- Card text reads like a printed card, with Compare and owned counts.
- Collection reads each pack from its own card list and finds custom pack covers.
- New card art; open Settings and pick Download / Update Art to get it.

Getting around
- Back and forward, Ctrl+F, saved searches, copying cards, undoable deck deletes, and the window remembers its size and place.
- My Decks shows each deck as one tile; the Shop and Deck Builder were redrawn.
- Dropdown lists fade in right under the mouse.
- Secret cards stay hidden on every screen.

Faster
- The Pack Builder and Database scroll smoothly and load art without stalling the window.
